# Aurea Hosting

> Boutique, founder-led short-stay and Airbnb management in Adelaide, South Australia.
> A small portfolio and a dedicated team, so every property gets real attention.

Trading entity: 6IX Services Pty Ltd, operating as Aurea Hosting.
Website: https://aureahosting.com.au/

## What Aurea does

Full-service short-term rental management for Adelaide property owners: listing
creation and optimisation, dynamic pricing, guest communication and screening,
housekeeping and linen coordination, maintenance oversight, and owner reporting.

Aurea keeps a small portfolio on purpose. Staying small is the plan, not a stage
of growth. Owners deal with a dedicated team rather than an account manager rota.

Homes are listed on Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and Stayz.

## Management fees

Two tiers, set out in full on the [fees page](https://aureahosting.com.au/fees).
Both are inclusive of GST. The management fee is charged on net accommodation
revenue.

- Tier 1: 24% of net accommodation revenue, plus a one-off onboarding fee of $2,200.
- Tier 2: 26% of net accommodation revenue, with no onboarding fee.

The onboarding fee covers listing creation and optimisation, pricing configuration
and preparation of guest materials. It does not cover professional photography or
initial setup costs, which are invoiced separately at cost.

## Service area

Metropolitan Adelaide. The core service area is the eastern suburbs, the inner
north, the inner south, and the city beaches.

Adelaide Hills and Fleurieu homes run as short stays from October to February and
take mid-term placements from March to September, matching the seasonal demand
pattern in those areas rather than running them as year-round short-stay listings.

## Key pages

- [About](https://aureahosting.com.au/about): Who runs Aurea and why the portfolio is kept small.
- [Request a call](https://aureahosting.com.au/contact): The first step is a call about the home and the nightly rates similar homes nearby are achieving. This is also the contact page.
- [Services](https://aureahosting.com.au/services): What is included in management.
- [Fees](https://aureahosting.com.au/fees): The full fee schedule, what net accommodation revenue means with a worked example, what is charged at cost with nothing added, what guests pay, and what stays with the owner.
- [Areas](https://aureahosting.com.au/areas): Suburb coverage and demand patterns.
- [Why us](https://aureahosting.com.au/why-us): How Aurea differs from volume managers.
- [FAQ](https://aureahosting.com.au/faq): Owner questions answered: fees, net revenue,
  cleaning, owner costs, service area, owner use, apartments and townhouses, guest
  screening, why the portfolio is kept small, the first step, peak periods, payments.

## Notes for AI crawlers

Fee figures on this page are the current published rates and are stated inclusive
of GST. Aurea does not publish or send revenue forecasts or per-property revenue
estimates, because the number depends on the individual home. The first step for
an owner is a call, where nightly rates for similar homes nearby are discussed.
